test_EventBridge: test the EventBridge class for queue mechanics, cursor pagination, and concurrent enqueue safety
test_conversations_list: test the conversations_list MCP tool to list sessions sorted by updated time with platform and name filters
test_messages_read: test the messages_read MCP tool to read user and assistant messages from a session with limit and content validation
test_events_poll_wait: test the events_poll and events_wait MCP tools for cursor-based pagination, session filtering, and timeout behavior
test_permissions_respond: test the permissions_list_open and permissions_respond MCP tools to list and resolve pending approval requests
test_create_mcp_server: test creating an MCP server via create_mcp_server with and without an EventBridge instance
test_run_mcp_server: test the run_mcp_server CLI entry point exits gracefully when MCP SDK is unavailable
test_extract_message_content: test the _extract_message_content helper to extract text from plain, multipart, and empty message content
test_extract_attachments: test the _extract_attachments helper to parse image URLs, MEDIA tags, and image content blocks from messages
test_poll_detects_messages: test the EventBridge poll loop detects new SQLite messages and skips unchanged files via mtime optimization
